name: clipy
description: Clipy plugins for Claude Code. Show your AI agent your screen, or let it watch any video: YouTube, Loom or a file on your machine.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: /watch a YouTube video, a Loom link or a local video file, then ask about it. Answers cite timestamps.

plugins.name: record
plugins.description: /record your screen and talk Claude through it. Claude reads the recording (transcript, key moments, screenshots) and gets to work. Stays on your computer, Mac or Windows.

plugins.name: clipy-record
plugins.description: A Record button above the prompt. Show Claude your screen and talk it through, press stop, and Claude reads the recording and gets to work.
